_help: HOW TO EDIT: Each notice is one {...} block in the "announcements" list. ADD: copy a block, paste it, change values. date format MUST be YYYY-MM-DD. Newest dates show first automatically. Notices from the last 30 days get a NEW badge. pdf: put the file in assets/pdf/ and write "assets/pdf/filename.pdf" (or "" if none). course: a course code or "". REMOVE: delete the block and its comma. The records below are SAMPLES.
